description:
The first MCP server that completes real hotel reservations inside AI conversations. 300K+ properties across 140+ countries — major chains, independents, boutiques. Real confirmation numbers, loyalty program eligibility (Hilton, Marriott, IHG), and secure PCI-compliant checkout.

Builders monetize every booking via Stripe Connect — set your own fee, get paid directly.

Quick connect: npx 1stay-mcp

7 tools: search_hotels, get_hotel_details, book_hotel, get_booking, cancel_booking, retrieve_booking, search_tools

Endpoint: https://mcp.stayker.com/mcp | OAuth 2.1 | Streamable HTTP

Playground: 1stay.ai/playground

Built on proven travel distribution architecture by Stayker.
